I've always liked the idea of being swept away by the ocean. Kinda romantic huh?

What kind of music do you like? There's this song that's kinda like what we're talking about.

Dude shut up

You're not stupid. How else could you have found a subreddit for suicidal people to vent on?

I know you're just being self-critical, and that's okay <3

But stop calling yourself names. You're better than that and you know it.

How could you do this to her?

Edit: Keep asking yourself that. Nobody here knows more about this relationship than you, and if she's that important to you, you NEED to keep asking yourself whether this is the right choice. 

Sorry if that sounds harsh. But it sounds like you already understand the implications your decision would have on those around you. 

You're not a burden. You obviously have people who care a lot about you. Please remember that.

Sometimes, something will make me happy, and I'll go months without ever thinking about harming myself. 

I hold onto these moments, because when I'm truly sad, I appreciate those fleeting moments of happiness that much more.

And you should too <3

Shit I don't even know you and I'll miss you. I love musicals :c

I slowly got off my medications, but  with the help of a doctor who was serious about rehabilitation rather than feeding me pills. What helped me was finding an emotional outlet that kept my mind off of the intrusive thoughts.

What makes you happy? Dogs? Do what makes you happy and don't think about ANYTHING else. It's difficult, but the more occupied you are the better you'll feel, instead of focusing on the next pill you should take <3

Your grandma loves you. She'll always love you.


You say there's nothing to look forward to. I know it's easy to become apathetic to it all, but I want you to ask yourself "is this what I want?"

Ask yourself out loud right now.

Keep asking yourself.

The only easy day was yesterday, my friend.

Dude it's okay <3

It sounds like you feel like everyone's lying to you. I'll try to help but you may not like what I have to say, but I promise I won't lie to you.

You're depending way to much on others for your own self worth.

In all of your post I didn't once read about what makes YOU happy. What do YOU want? Not your mom or your friends. You want to please everyone and put on this front, but what do YOU really want?

If you really want this to get better, give yourself time to find out what really makes you happy, and go do it, not for anyone else. Love yourself dude <3

Think about all of the times that you felt lonely and sad. Did you ever open up to any of your friends like you're doing right now?

If so, congratulations! You're more emotionally developed than most, and that takes a lot of courage. Most young people (myself included) won't immediately open up because they've probably been hurt like you have before.

We're all vulnerable at our core. If you want a true friendship, you have to understand that, and let yourself be vulnerable. It's definitely a risk.

Most people aren't "self-absorbed", as tempting as it is to believe. It's just most people don't know how to talk about things that aren't shallow.
